You may not alter the images provided, other than to crop them to size. " When deploying deep learning models in high-stakes scenarios, researchers would like to understand how they work. Today, this requires unraveling an enormously complex network of internal processing nodes to understand what the model knows and how it will likely behave in practice. Jacob Andreas would rather have the models explain themselves. The newly tenured associate professor develops techniques that enable artificial intelligence models to communicate accurately about what they learned from their training data, in language humans can understand.

sec.title: Uber says nearly 150,000 impacted by third-party breach
sec.brief: S. In breach notification letters, the rideshare company said it was notified by a third party service provider on October 9 that internal credentials were stolen and used to access Uber’s account. Uber’s investigation into the incident found that the hackers accessed images of driver’s licenses and extracted text data, including names, addresses, dates of birth and driver’s license numbers. The impacted data was in a cloud storage environment created by Uber specifically to enable the service provider’s work. Uber did not respond to requests for comment about the name of the provider. Uber said it immediately severed its data connections to the provider once it was notified of the cyberattack and its investigation into the attack is ongoing. The company has since deleted or rotated credentials and access information associated with the service provider.
